title: OAEP execution event
description: Draft oaep/0.1 event envelope (PRD §8). Events are committed into a Merkle structure whose root is the receipt trace_root (PRD §10). Hash, JCS, and leaf encoding: docs/canonical.md. This schema does not implement a hosted verifier.

version.description: Protocol version tag. Must be the string oaep/0.1 for this schema.

execution_id.description: Execution this event belongs to. Same value as the parent receipt execution_id.

event_id.description: Optional unique id for this event. Produced values are the event nonce as 0x-hex (docs/canonical.md).

seq.description: Order of this event within the execution trace. Unstable: may become a hash-linked predecessor pointer.

occurred_at.description: When the event occurred. Optional; clock source is unstable.

commitment.description: Commitment to this event's payload: SHA-256(JCS(payload) || nonce) (docs/canonical.md).

payload.description: Type-specific event data. Unstable in oaep/0.1 — verifiers MUST NOT require payload keys for Level-0. Use this object for selective-disclosure preimages later, not for raw private prompts (PRD §25).

hexBytes.description: 0x-prefixed hex. Produced SHA-256 values are 32 bytes (docs/canonical.md).

eventType.description: Execution-event types from PRD §8. Additional types require a protocol revision or an explicit extension field (not defined here).
